anchor.semantic_hook: The literal act of taking an effect becomes a giant mechanical hand lifting the first moving tile from a cause-and-effect chain.
anchor.setting: A quiet administrative hall contains a long counter, blank document folders, a hand-only clock, and a chain of plain standing tiles. The chain begins beneath a giant mechanical hand that physically lifts the first falling tile, the room's single surreal element. Each lifted tile exposes a waiting official object beneath it.
